description.en: Feishu (Lark) UI for DeepSeek Harness — a panel-driven control console: every slash command is a button on the control-panel card, in-card approvals and questions, live streaming cards, and one-QR app setup.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书 UI：面板驱动控制台，每个斜杠命令都是控制面板卡片上的按钮，卡内审批与提问，流式卡片，扫码一次完成配置。
